name: How long does it take to build a tiny home shell?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a tiny home shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction time for a tiny home shell typically varies based on the design complexity, size, and current project queue. Generally, a standard shell build at Zen Tiny Homes can take approximately 4 to 8 weeks from the start of construction to completion. This timeline accounts for acquiring materials, framing, roofing, window installation, and ensuring the structure is fully weather-tight. We provide a more precise estimate after understanding your specific design requirements and current lead times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a tiny home shell typically takes 4 to 8 weeks, depending on design complexity and size.
